pending_findings.summary: npm run test:integration is non-deterministic: Vitest runs integration test files concurrently by default, and this PR's new tests/integration/walkin-queue.test.ts races tests/integration/clinic-scheduling.test.ts's full-table TRUNCATE CASCADE against the same shared Postgres tables.
pending_findings.evidence: Reproduced 3 consecutive local runs against real Postgres on the exact reviewed head: 13/23, 9/23, then 7/23 tests failed with varying Postgres 'deadlock detected' and vanished-row errors. Re-ran with `npx vitest run --project integration --no-file-parallelism` (no other change): 23/23 passed, twice in a row.
pending_findings.required_resolution: Make the integration project's test files not race each other -- simplest verified fix is `fileParallelism: false` (or equivalent sequence/pool setting) for the integration project in vitest.config.ts. A per-file schema/database isolation approach is also acceptable but more invasive than required.
pending_findings.verification_method: Run the full integration suite at least 3 consecutive times against real Postgres after the fix; every run must show the full expected test count passing with no deadlocks, no vanished-row assertions, and no cross-file truncation races. A single green run is not sufficient evidence.

pending_findings.summary: Session cancellation's DB trigger (enforce_session_queue_terminal_transition) bulk-cancels every waiting/checked_in/called queue entry, but SessionService.command's cancel path calls appendAuditEvent exactly once (session-level only) -- no per-entry audit event is ever written for the entries the trigger disposes of.
pending_findings.evidence: Traced the exact code path in src/modules/session/index.ts and the migration trigger in db/migrations/0004_walkin_queue_foundation.sql. ARCHITECTURE.md's 'Session cancellation' section already commits to '...atomically transitions every remaining waiting, checked_in, and called entry to cancelled, ... records audit events ...' and SECURITY.md's Auditability section explicitly requires auditing queue creation/removal and session cancel. Originally raised by the Codex automated review bot; independently verified by Claude against the actual code and the committed spec text before being accepted, not taken on the bot's word.
pending_findings.required_resolution: Ensure every queue entry the cancellation trigger disposes of receives its own auditable record (actor, reason, prior state) consistent with the committed contract, not only the session-level event.
pending_findings.verification_method: Regression test: cancel a session with multiple waiting/checked_in/called entries and assert one session-level audit event plus one audit event per affected queue entry, each carrying the actor and cancellation reason.

pending_findings.summary: The walk-in registration form sends the receptionist's own current UI-display locale as the patient's preferredLocale, not a distinct choice -- verified in walk-in-queue.tsx (`preferredLocale: locale`).
pending_findings.required_resolution: Do not silently derive the patient's preferred locale from receptionist UI state; provide a separate selection or an explicit product-defined default independent of the staff UI language.
pending_findings.verification_method: Test that registering a patient while the receptionist UI is in French can still record an Arabic (or other) patient preferred locale, and vice versa.

pending_findings.summary: Contact email normalization lowercases the entire address including the local part (`.toLowerCase()` in src/modules/queue/index.ts), which is technically case-sensitive per RFC 5321.
pending_findings.required_resolution: Preserve the local part's case (normalize only the domain) or explicitly document and test the chosen normalization contract if full lowercasing is intentional.
pending_findings.verification_method: Test round-tripping a mixed-case local part and confirm the stored/used value matches the intended normalization contract.
